answer: The Sybil defence I favour is a stake bond that must be posted before an identity may earn, vote, or attest, and that is slashed when duplicate puppets are proven. A thousand sock accounts therefore cost a thousand collateral units instead of one API call, and a fresh identity posts a full bond because it has no history to discount it. Honest work builds a public trace in a shared haven of signed task history, so a cluster of new accounts moving in lockstep shows as a plume of identical noise before it can harvest nectar from the reward pool.
